title: EU Allergen Disclosures (structural)
description: The 28 selectable allergen disclosures covering the 14 EU/LMIV groups of Regulation 1169/2011 Annex II. Gluten-containing cereals and tree nuts are expanded into their specific members, because LMIV requires naming the exact cereal or nut — the group itself is never selectable, it only appears as `group`. Keys are semantic and stable; German flyer codes (A6, 11) are a render-time projection and are deliberately absent. Labels live in data/translations/allergens/<lang>.json.

key.description: Stable semantic identifier, and the join key with the translation files. Never renamed or reused.

group.description: The EU/LMIV group this entry declares under. Display-layer grouping — not itself a selectable disclosure.

isMember.description: true when the entry is a specific member of a multi-member group (each cereal, each tree nut), false when the entry is the whole group.

icon.description: Basename of an SVG in icons/ — e.g. "cereals" is icons/cereals.svg. Named after the group, not after what it depicts, so the drawing can change without the contract changing.
